title: Start ups, please don't force me to log in with Facebook
guide_zh: 用户呼吁创业公司提供 Facebook 登录之外的认证选择。
author: eof
excerpt: I have been to a number of sites that I want to try out but give up when they force me to log in with 'connect with ' facebook. I know most people have it, but some don't. I don't. You should really have your own authentication in my opinion, but if you insist on not, at least give me a few options.
